salah_astaghfirullah_salam.title: Seeking Forgiveness After Salam
salah_astaghfirullah_salam.arabicText: أَسْـتَغْفِرُ الله (ثَلاثاً) اللّهُـمَّ أَنْـتَ السَّلامُ وَمِـنْكَ السَّلام تَبارَكْتَ يا ذا الجَـلالِ وَالإِكْـرام
salah_astaghfirullah_salam.transliteration: Astaghfirullāh (three times). Allāhumma antas-salām, wa minkas-salām, tabārakta yā dhal-jalāli wal-ikrām.
salah_astaghfirullah_salam.translation: I seek the forgiveness of Allah (three times). O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Owner of majesty and honor.
salah_astaghfirullah_salam.benefit: The Prophet (ﷺ) would begin his remembrance after every prescribed prayer by seeking Allah's forgiveness three times, then glorifying Him as the Source of peace.

salah_la_ilaha_wahdahu.title: Declaration of Allah's Oneness
salah_la_ilaha_wahdahu.arabicText: لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّهُ وحدَهُ لا شريكَ لهُ لهُ المُـلْكُ ولهُ الحَمْد وهوَ على كلّ شَيءٍ قَدير اللّهُـمَّ لا مانِعَ لِما أَعْطَـيْت وَلا مُعْطِـيَ لِما مَنَـعْت وَلا يَنْفَـعُ ذا الجَـدِّ مِنْـكَ الجَـد
salah_la_ilaha_wahdahu.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamd, wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. Allāhumma lā māniʿa limā aʿṭayt, wa lā muʿṭiya limā manaʿt, wa lā yanfaʿu dhal-jaddi minkal-jadd.
salah_la_ilaha_wahdahu.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, He has no partner, His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is Able to do all things. O Allah, there is none who can withhold what You give, and none may give what You have withheld, and the might of the mighty person cannot benefit him against You.
salah_la_ilaha_wahdahu.benefit: The Prophet (ﷺ) said this after every prescribed prayer, affirming Allah's oneness and that none can withhold what He gives nor give what He withholds.

salah_la_hawla.title: No Power Except with Allah
salah_la_hawla.arabicText: لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّه وحدَهُ لا شريكَ لهُ لهُ الملكُ ولهُ الحَمد وهوَ على كلّ شيءٍ قدير لا حَـوْلَ وَلا قـوَّةَ إِلاّ بِاللهِ لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّـه وَلا نَعْـبُـدُ إِلاّ إيّـاه لَهُ النِّعْـمَةُ وَلَهُ الفَضْل وَلَهُ الثَّـناءُ الحَـسَن لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّهُ مخْلِصـينَ لَـهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَـرِهَ الكـافِرون
salah_la_hawla.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamd, wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. Lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh, lā ilāha illallāh, wa lā naʿbudu illā iyyāh, lahun-niʿmatu wa lahul-faḍl, wa lahuth-thanāʾul-ḥasan, lā ilāha illallāhu mukhliṣīna lahud-dīn, wa law karihal-kāfirūn.
salah_la_hawla.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, He has no partner, His is the dominion and His is the praise and He is Able to do all things. There is no power and no might except by Allah. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah, and we do not worship any other besides Him. His is grace, and His is bounty, and to Him belongs the most excellent praise. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah; (we are) sincere in making our religious devotion to Him, even though the disbelievers may dislike it.
salah_la_hawla.benefit: The Prophet (ﷺ) would declare after every prayer that all power, grace, and excellent praise belong to Allah alone, worshipping Him sincerely even if the disbelievers dislike it.

salah_tasbih_after_prayer.title: Tasbih After Prayer (33x Each)
salah_tasbih_after_prayer.arabicText: سُـبْحانَ اللهِ والحَمْـدُ لله واللهُ أكْـبَر (ثلاثاً وثلاثين) لا إلهَ إلاّ اللّهُ وَحْـدَهُ لا شريكَ لهُ لهُ الملكُ ولهُ الحَمْد وهُوَ على كُلّ شَيءٍ قَـدير
salah_tasbih_after_prayer.transliteration: Subḥānallāh, walḥamdu lillāh, wallāhu akbar (each 33 times). Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamd, wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.
salah_tasbih_after_prayer.translation: Glory be to Allah (33 times), praise be to Allah (33 times), and Allah is the Greatest (33 times). Then to complete one hundred, recite once: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner; to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
salah_tasbih_after_prayer.benefit: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Whoever says this after every prayer will be forgiven his sins even though they be as the foam of the sea.

salah_ikhlas.title: Surah Al-Ikhlas (The Sincerity)
salah_ikhlas.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ۔ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ۔ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ۔ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
salah_ikhlas.transliteration: Qul huwa Allāhu aḥad. Allāhu aṣ-ṣamad. Lam yalid wa lam yūlad. Wa lam yakun lahū kufuwan aḥad.
salah_ikhlas.translation: Say: He is Allah, One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. Nor is there to Him any equivalent.
salah_ikhlas.benefit: The Prophet (ﷺ) instructed that these three protective surahs be recited after every prayer.
salah_ikhlas.reference: Abu Dawud 2/86, An-Nasa'i 3/68; Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/8 | Hisnul Muslim 70

salah_falaq.title: Surah Al-Falaq (The Daybreak)
salah_falaq.frequency: 1x after every prayer (3x after Fajr & Maghrib)
salah_falaq.arabicText: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ۔ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ۔ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ۔ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ۔ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
salah_falaq.transliteration: Qul a'ūdhu bi-rabb al-falaq. Min sharri mā khalaq. Wa min sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab. Wa min sharri an-naffāthāti fī al-'uqad. Wa min sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad.
salah_falaq.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak. From the evil of that which He created. And from the evil of darkness when it settles. And from the evil of the blowers in knots. And from the evil of an envier when he envies.
salah_falaq.benefit: The Prophet (ﷺ) instructed that these three protective surahs be recited after every prayer; after Fajr and Maghrib they are recited three times each.
salah_falaq.reference: Abu Dawud 2/86, An-Nasa'i 3/68; Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/8 | Hisnul Muslim 70

salah_nas.title: Surah An-Nas (Mankind)
salah_nas.frequency: 1x after every prayer (3x after Fajr & Maghrib)
salah_nas.arabicText: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ۔ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ۔ إِلَهِ النَّاسِ۔ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ۔ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ۔ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
salah_nas.transliteration: Qul a'ūdhu bi-rabb an-nās. Malik an-nās. Ilāh an-nās. Min sharri al-waswāsi al-khannās. Alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūr an-nās. Min al-jinnati wa an-nās.
salah_nas.translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind. The Sovereign of mankind. The God of mankind. From the evil of the retreating whisperer. Who whispers in the breasts of mankind. From among jinn and mankind.
salah_nas.benefit: The Prophet (ﷺ) instructed that these three protective surahs be recited after every prayer; after Fajr and Maghrib they are recited three times each.
salah_nas.reference: Abu Dawud 2/86, An-Nasa'i 3/68; Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/8 | Hisnul Muslim 70

salah_ayatul_kursi.title: Ayatul Kursi
salah_ayatul_kursi.arabicText: اللّهُ لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
salah_ayatul_kursi.transliteration: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwal-ḥayyul-qayyūm, lā taʾkhudhuhu sinatun wa lā nawm, lahu mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍ, man dhal-ladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahu illā bi-idhnih, yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wa mā khalfahum, wa lā yuḥīṭūna bi-shayʾin min ʿilmihi illā bimā shāʾ, wasiʿa kursiyyuhus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, wa lā yaʾūduhu ḥifẓuhumā, wa huwal-ʿaliyyul-ʿaẓīm.
salah_ayatul_kursi.translation: Allah! There is none worthy of worship but He, the Ever-Living, the One Who sustains and protects all that exists. Neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is he that can intercede with Him except with His Permission? He knows what happens to them in this world and what will happen to them in the Hereafter. And they will never encompass anything of His Knowledge except that which He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and He feels no fatigue in guarding and preserving them. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
salah_ayatul_kursi.benefit: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Whoever recites Ayatul Kursi after every prescribed prayer, nothing stands between him and Paradise except death.
salah_ayatul_kursi.reference: An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah 100, Ibn As-Sunni 121; Al-Albani, Sahihul-Jami' 5/339 | Hisnul Muslim 71

salah_la_ilaha_yuhyi.title: Ten Times After Fajr & Maghrib
salah_la_ilaha_yuhyi.arabicText: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
salah_la_ilaha_yuhyi.transliteration: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamd, yuḥyī wa yumīt, wa huwa ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.
salah_la_ilaha_yuhyi.translation: None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise. He brings life and He causes death, and He is Able to do all things.
salah_la_ilaha_yuhyi.benefit: The Prophet (ﷺ) taught that this declaration of Allah's oneness — He who gives life and causes death — be repeated ten times after the Maghrib and Fajr prayers.

salah_ilman_nafian.title: Du'a for Beneficial Knowledge
salah_ilman_nafian.arabicText: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نافِعاً وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
salah_ilman_nafian.transliteration: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka ʿilman nāfiʿan, wa rizqan ṭayyiban, wa ʿamalan mutaqabbalan.
salah_ilman_nafian.translation: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial, and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable.
salah_ilman_nafian.benefit: The Prophet (ﷺ) would say this after giving salam from the Fajr prayer, asking Allah for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds to begin the day.
salah_ilman_nafian.reference: Ibn Majah; Sahih Ibn Majah 1/152, Majma' Az-Zawa'id 10/111 | Hisnul Muslim 73
